    The graded algebra 𝒪P and its reduction #

    For a ray table P with a degree function on the rays, the linearization 𝒪P over any commutative ring is graded by the degrees of the rays (galgLin), and reduction of coefficients along a ring map is a ring map 𝒪P → kP (redLin). This is the algebra A^{(4)} = 𝒪P of integral-deformations.tex.

    ↥(P.Lin O) →ₗ[O] ↥(P.Lin O)
